creator: Alexander Terp
description:
An agent that started a pane without `--helper` cannot make it a helper later. Helper status is set at `pane new` and kept for good (`muster docs agents`, 'An agent's helpers'), so the only remedy is `pane hide` plus `pane quiet`, which leaves out what makes a helper worth having: the maker link (`maker` in `muster window --json`, `pane show --helpers-of`) and the @muster notices to the maker when the pane is blocked, stuck, or idle without having reported. **Seen:** 2026-10-18, an integrator running a parallel round spawned two worker panes as plain splits, because the parallel-work skill's spawn example has no `--helper`, then could not turn them into its helpers once the person asked why they were not. **Idea:** a verb that records an existing pane as a helper of a maker, such as `muster pane adopt --pane

[--helper-of ]` (the maker defaulting to the calling pane), with the same effect as having made it with `--helper`: hidden and quiet unless told otherwise, listed under its maker, and watched for the maker's notices. The reverse (release a helper into an ordinary pane) may want the same verb. The skill-side fix, spawning workers with `--helper` in the first place, is on the owner's tooling-feedback board.
title: Make an open pane another pane's helper
